{{Quote|Naga Sadow, are you ready for the mark?|The Sith Councilor|<ref name="TGAotS4">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 4|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 4]]</ref>}}
A '''Sith Lord''' of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]] served as a member of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire's]] [[Sith Council|ruling council]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] leading up to the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] of [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. After their fellow [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] had staged what the Sith Council assumed to have been a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[First raid on the Sith Citadel|attack]] that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the Councilor supported Sadow's bid for the title of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] of the Sith Empire. Later, the Councilor performed a private ceremony where they branded the newly elected Sadow with the [[Mark of Dark Lord of the Sith|emblem]] of the Dark Lords.

==Biography==
===Attack on the Sith Empire===
{{Quote|We've been attacked!|The Sith Councilor|<ref name="TGAotS3" />}}
[[File:Sith_council_2.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The Sith Councilor pledged their support to the new Dark Lord of the Sith, Naga Sadow.]]
A [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who ruled over a dozen [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] served as a member of its [[Sith Council]]<ref name="TGAotS3" /> by [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of the ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] mini-series to [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].</ref> when the [[Scout/Legends|explorers]] [[Gav Daragon|Gav]] and [[Jori Daragon]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Koros system]] arrived in [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Space]], the Sith Councilor's fellow Sith Lord [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] plotted to use their arrival to force the Sith Empire into a new phase of expansion via an invasion of the Republic. To that end, Sadow violently [[First raid on the Sith Citadel|liberated]] the Daragon siblings from their [[Prison/Legends|imprisonment]] on the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], in the process planting as evidence Republic [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]].<ref name="TGAotS3" />

Sadow's actions led the Sith Council to believe the Daragons were Republic [[Spy/Legends|spies]] and that their liberation was a precursor to a Republic invasion of the Sith Empire. When Sadow arrived from his [[Naga Sadow's Khar Shian citadel|hidden stronghold]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Khar Shian]] to an emergency session of the Council held in Ziost's [[Sith Citadel (Ziost)|Sith Citadel]] and, feigning ignorance of the recent events, demanded to know the reason behind the meeting, the Sith Councilor informed him that the empire had experienced an attack. The Councilor then observed Sadow as he was publicly inspecting one of the weapons planted during the raid, in the process proclaiming his unfamiliarity with the item.<ref name="TGAotS3" />

===A new Dark Lord===
{{Quote|It must be Naga Sadow.|The Sith Councilor|<ref name="TGAotS3" />}}
[[File:SadowReadyForBrandingCeremony-TGAotS4.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Sith Councilor performed a branding ceremony on Naga Sadow.]]
In a speech subsequently delivered to the Sith Council, Sadow used the recent events as an argument for both crowning him as the new [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] of the empire and launching a conquest of the Republic. Being a part of the majority of the councilmembers that expressed support for Sadow's candidature, the Sith Councilor proclaimed that it was indeed Sadow who needed to be elected the new leader of the empire. After Sadow's rival, [[Ludo Kressh]], and [[Ludo Kressh's faction|his supporters]] stormed out of the Council chamber in protest over Sadow's election, the Sith Councilor and their remaining peers all bowed to Sadow as their new Dark Lord. Meanwhile, Sadow instructed all of them to rally their [[Warship/Legends|warships]] and [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] for an upcoming invasion of the Republic.<ref name="TGAotS3" />

Later, the Sith Councilor and<ref name="TGAotS4" /> [[Unidentified Sith Councilor (crystal vessel)|one]] of their fellow councilmembers<ref name="TGAotS3" /> took part in the private ceremony of Sadow receiving the [[mark of Dark Lord of the Sith]]. During the ritual, the Councilor took from their colleague a [[Crystal/Legends|crystalline]] vessel containing a pair of [[Sith pincerbug|arthropods]]. Then, after confirming that Sadow was ready for the procedure, the Councilor released the [[Arthropod/Legends|arthropods]] on Sadow's forehead, where the creatures burned the emblem of the Dark Lords into the new Sith ruler's skin. At the conclusion of the ceremony, both of the Sith Lords performing the ritual bowed to Sadow, with the Sith Councilor also expressing verbally their subservience to the new Dark Lord.<ref name="TGAotS4" />

==Personality and traits==
As a Sith Lord of the Sith Empire and a member of the empire's Sith Council, the Sith Councilor was loyal to the Dark Lord of the Sith. They were a member of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]] and had [[Color/Legends|red]] skin and brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and beard. The Councilor wore their hair long on the sides but only had very sparse hair on the top of their head, and they had on their forehead a black [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] depicting an abstract symbol.<ref name="TGAotS3" />

==Equipment==
The Sith Councilor wore purple [[Robe/Legends|robes]] with gold-colored upper-torso [[Armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="TGAotS3" /> They also wore a golden headdress and a pair of ornamental [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlets]] of matching color.<ref name="TGAotS4" /> The Councilor was equipped with a [[Sith sword]] with a jagged blade.<ref name="TGAotS3" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith Councilor first appeared in the [[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 3|third issue]] of [[Dark Horse Comics]]' ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] mini-series. The issue was written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]], penciled by [[Dario Carrasco, Jr.]],<ref name="TGAotS3" /> and published on [[December 11]], [[1996]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54592/star_wars_tales_of_the_jedi_-_the_golden_age_of_the_sith_1996_3|text=Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi - The Golden Age of the Sith (1996) #3}}</ref>
